top.text: Actually, the index on email is useless here — the LOWER() function prevents it from being used. Query will full-scan. Need a functional index: CREATE INDEX idx_users_email_lower ON users (LOWER(email)); Or use citext / ILIKE. #SQL #Database
top.translationZh: 其实这里email字段的索引根本没用——LOWER()函数会让索引失效，查询会走全表扫描。需要建个函数索引：CREATE INDEX idx_users_email_lower ON users (LOWER(email)); 或者直接用citext/ILIKE。#SQL #Database
